title: Terraform modules and GitHub Actions pipeline for a new GCP environment
description:
Fixed-price project. We are moving two containerized services (Node.js API and a Python worker) from Heroku to Google Cloud. Scope: Terraform for the network, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL (Postgres) and Secret Manager; separate staging and production; a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds, tests and deploys on merge; basic monitoring and alerting. Handover documentation is required.

Budget is fixed. Timeline: 4 weeks.
